nodes.why: 回溯锚点；旗舰沉于避风湾内。
nodes.scene: 唤醒基础军团，选择开局倾向，与旧部交谈。
nodes.plot: 每轮从此开始，只有王子保留亲历记忆。
nodes.eng: The Ferryman raises the wreck where the relief fleet was betrayed. Every Return begins here.
nodes.scene_en: Wake the company; choose a starting doctrine and speak to the crew.
nodes.consequence_en: No worldly gains persist across the Return.
nodes.consequence_zh: 现世收益不跨回溯保留。

nodes.why: 湾外最近的打捞岛；必须取得小艇与本地通行能力。
nodes.scene: 抢占打捞码头，防止守军转移小艇；两处登陆滩。
nodes.plot: 找到旗舰的一块军旗碎片；确认不是所有遇难者都能被安葬。
nodes.eng: Secure salvage craft and a landing. A torn banner connects the company to the wreck.
nodes.scene_en: Take the salvage pier before defenders move the boats; two beach approaches.
nodes.reward_en: Landing craft: improve the first deployment
nodes.consequence_en: Recover a usable boat and open the coastal/pilot passages.
nodes.consequence_zh: 回收可用小艇，打开沿岸与引航水路。

nodes.why: 沿外岛岸线南下，接管信号灯。
nodes.scene: 在灯塔发出警报前夺取它；低处码头更安全但绕路。
nodes.plot: 灯塔曾收到禁止搜救的命令；家属一直为失踪者添灯油。
nodes.reward: 侦察：额外预览下一处遭遇
nodes.eng: The signal ledger records an order forbidding rescue.
nodes.scene_en: Capture the beacon before its warning reaches the next garrison; the lower pier is a safer but longer approach.
nodes.reward_en: Scout: preview one additional next encounter
nodes.consequence_en: A captured signal ledger helps establish the rescue ban; suppression reduces one reinforcement event.
nodes.consequence_zh: 信号簿佐证禁救令；压制信号可减少一次增援。

nodes.why: 沿近岸航道抵达港税和渔船集散地。
nodes.scene: 穿过仓库巷道或突击暴露码头；避免误毁民用货物。
nodes.plot: 伯爵罗德里克支付佣兵费用，并安排船队改航。获得一封未寄家书的线索。
nodes.eng: Customs papers connect the Earl to the mercenaries and the diversion.
nodes.scene_en: Fight through warehouse alleys or cross the exposed quay; protect civilian cargo from incidental damage.
nodes.consequence_en: Customs records and surviving dock officials can support the palace confrontation.
nodes.consequence_zh: 港税账簿及存续官吏可支援宫城对质。

nodes.why: 从湾外往东横渡短距离水面；先占引航站。
nodes.scene: 夺取潮汐堤道连接的两处海图房；随潮位选择登陆点。
nodes.plot: 海图证明当日所谓航道危险的通报是伪造的。
nodes.eng: The original chart contradicts the false warning that diverted the fleet.
nodes.scene_en: Secure two chart huts linked by a tidal causeway; choose a landing while the tide changes.
nodes.consequence_en: Restore the charted northern and central crossings.
nodes.consequence_zh: 恢复北峡及中央海道的海图通行。

nodes.why: 引航岛取得海图后可攻克北方双堡。
nodes.scene: 攻破双锁链塔，压制守军后控制绞盘。
nodes.plot: 元帅休亲自签署封湾军令；他认为牺牲王子能避免内战。
nodes.eng: Hugh’s signed naval orders establish his role in the betrayal.
nodes.scene_en: Break the two chain towers; occupy the winch after suppressing the defending formation.
nodes.consequence_en: Open the military passage; recover Hugh’s order, not a blanket declaration of his death.
nodes.consequence_zh: 打开军用海道并取得休的军令；不默认宣告其死亡。

nodes.why: 北峡通行后沿森林海岸进入王家军工港。
nodes.scene: 阻止援船离港，控制滑道和船坞。
nodes.plot: 船厂工匠也受旧征发令约束；部分海军愿意效忠合法君主。
nodes.eng: The shipyard reveals the cost of requisition and weakens royal naval reinforcement.
nodes.scene_en: Disable launch ramps and seize the dry dock before a relief ship departs.
nodes.consequence_en: Reduce naval reinforcement; surviving crews may offer present-run testimony.
nodes.consequence_zh: 削弱海军增援；存续船员可在本轮作证。

nodes.why: 沿引航岛或折桨港的传统渡线抵达古代纪念岛。
nodes.scene: 调查巨像铭文，在两处遗物中选择其一，无强制战斗。
nodes.plot: 历代君主曾以控制海道统一群岛；王国并非自古就依赖永昼。
nodes.reward: 王室遗物：指挥或阵形增益
nodes.eng: Monuments record the conquest of the Crownsea long before the eternal light.
nodes.scene_en: Inspect the monument inscriptions; choose one of two relic caches instead of a compulsory battle.
nodes.reward_en: Royal relic: command or formation bonus
nodes.consequence_en: Identify an old central anchorage; learn pre-Day history.
nodes.consequence_zh: 辨认古中央锚地；了解永昼以前的历史。

nodes.why: 内海中央锚地，连接商航与军事航路。
nodes.scene: 在巡逻船威胁登陆区时攻下锚地堡垒。
nodes.plot: 被扣押的赈粮清单指向粮仓女伯爵；王都商人开始动摇。
nodes.reward: 船队预备：补充部署次数
nodes.eng: The inner anchorage controls the merchant approach and holds missing relief manifests.
nodes.scene_en: Capture the harbour fort while patrol boats threaten the landing zone.
nodes.reward_en: Fleet reserve: replenish a deployment charge
nodes.consequence_en: Open the merchant or military approach; recover the relief manifest.
nodes.consequence_zh: 打开商港或军港进路，回收赈粮清单。

nodes.why: 折桨港外侧的南方引航港，通往河口与潮汐浅滩。
nodes.scene: 夺取引航码头并保护民居；浅水通道限制大型阵形。
nodes.plot: 失踪船员的家属在此等候；可依据已知家书内容寻找家人。
nodes.eng: A missing sailor’s family waits at the southern pilot station.
nodes.scene_en: Secure the pilot pier without destroying occupied homes; shallow channels limit large formations.
nodes.consequence_en: Gain coastal access and a chance to meet Pip’s family.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得沿岸通道，并可能与皮普家人会面。

nodes.why: 长灯岛西南旧港；第二阶段认识到战后补给的重要性。
nodes.scene: 勘察淤积港池并询问工人；选择修港建议或补给储藏。
nodes.plot: 发现永昼结束后可使用的替代港，但必须投入疏浚和储运。
nodes.eng: A viable alternative winter harbour, if its neglected facilities are restored.
nodes.scene_en: Inspect the silted basin and interview harbour workers; choose repair advice or a supply cache.
nodes.consequence_en: Record a credible winter-port restoration plan, not an instantly restored port.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得可行的冬港修复方案，而非立即修复港口。

nodes.why: 南方小艇沿河口浅水进入磨坊渡口。
nodes.scene: 在援兵过桥前控制磨桥，尽量保全磨坊。
nodes.plot: 王子的旧征发令仍被地方执行，受征者没有得到补偿。
nodes.eng: Edmund’s own emergency levy remains in force long after his death.
nodes.scene_en: Control the mill bridge before reinforcements cross; keep the mill intact if possible.
nodes.consequence_en: Recover copied requisition warrants and current claim receipts.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得征发令抄件及本轮欠账凭据。

nodes.why: 磨桥渡与长灯岛之间有粮运支流。
nodes.scene: 夺取配粮站瓦解征发守军，避开民用粮仓。
nodes.plot: 守军以服役换家人的口粮；王子的征发令曾经伤害这些人。
nodes.eng: The garrison fights for its families’ ration entitlements.
nodes.scene_en: Break the levy garrison by taking its ration station; avoid the civilian granary.
nodes.consequence_en: Open the grain route or tidal coast; preserved food matters in the settlement.
nodes.consequence_zh: 打开粮运或潮岸路线；保存的粮食影响战后安排。

nodes.why: 从麦尽村沿内河驳运线驶入粮仓港。
nodes.scene: 夺取三处仓门，压制守军而不焚毁粮储。
nodes.plot: 阿格尼丝扣押赈粮迫使王子出航。现存储备可以缓冲未来的冬季危机。
nodes.eng: Agnes’s records prove deliberate delays; preserved stores support a winter transition.
nodes.scene_en: Seize three warehouse gates; suppress the garrison without burning the food stores.
nodes.reward_en: Supply boon or a siege specialist
nodes.consequence_en: Intact stores support the Winter Council; if burned, the evidence survives but reserve support does not.
nodes.consequence_zh: 完整粮储支援冬政会议；焚毁则保留证据但失去粮储支持。

nodes.why: 万谷仓沿低地水道进入东向水闸。
nodes.scene: 控制两岸并操作水闸；桥路与渡船为不同进路。
nodes.plot: 王室工程曾将粮食送往旧王都；本轮取得粮运船队的支持。
nodes.eng: The lock opens the eastern grain passage and can support the capital’s food supply.
nodes.scene_en: Control both banks and operate the sluice; bridge and ferry provide distinct approaches.
nodes.consequence_en: Secure the grain convoy route into Sunhold.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得通往王都的粮运船队水道。

nodes.why: 从麦尽村或长灯岛沿南缘潮汐水道抵达古葬岛。
nodes.scene: 落潮时辨读葬碑，选择安全渡线或遗物。
nodes.plot: 早期死者直接渡入灰海；教会后来接管了送葬船。
nodes.eng: Old burial rites predate the Church’s control of the dead.
nodes.scene_en: Read the burial stones at low tide; choose a safe ferry route or a relic cache.
nodes.reward_en: Ward: limited resistance to holy attacks
nodes.consequence_en: Identify old funeral channels and rites without unlocking the Seal early.
nodes.consequence_zh: 辨认古葬水道与仪式，但不提前开放秘印。

nodes.why: 掌握古葬与旧航路后，可以从寂礁群或沉王群像前往。
nodes.scene: 穿过积水下厅；优先抄录盟约或查看奥斯温批注，安全时可兼取。
nodes.plot: 永昼起于大寒冬中的临时盟约，后逐渐依靠强制截留完整灵魂。
nodes.reward: 研究增益：提高冥火使用效率
nodes.eng: The founding compact records the Great Winter and the original temporary bargain.
nodes.scene_en: Navigate the flooded lower hall; choose to copy the founding charter or inspect Oswin’s notes, with both readable if safe.
nodes.consequence_en: K05 knowledge; copied evidence is run-local and supports the shutdown plan.
nodes.consequence_zh: 获得K05；抄本是本轮证据，支援停机方案。

nodes.why: 从引航岛沿北岸旧渡线登陆先王遗址。
nodes.scene: 勘察古渡阶梯与纪念室，回收王朝遗物。
nodes.plot: 发现王室曾在寒冬迁都，旧王国与今日政治体系并不相同。
nodes.eng: The abandoned dynastic route survives as a ferry crossing beneath the mountains.
nodes.scene_en: Survey the old ferry stairs and memorial rooms; recover a dynastic relic.
nodes.consequence_en: Find the old ferry passage and evidence of the winter relocation.
nodes.consequence_zh: 找到古渡通路及寒冬迁都证据。

nodes.why: 从王闸或沉水藏书阁沿东岸旧渡线登陆。
nodes.scene: 探访破损庄园，找到童年速写，不要求战斗。
nodes.plot: 兄妹童年在水沟里比赛木船；埃德蒙意识到妹妹已不再是需要他代作决定的孩子。
nodes.reward: 休整：选择轻量恢复增益
nodes.eng: A childhood memory of wooden boats opens a more personal conversation with Eleanor.
nodes.scene_en: Visit the damaged country house; recover a childhood sketch, with no garrison encounter required.
nodes.reward_en: Rest: select a modest recovery boon
nodes.consequence_en: Open the personal audience; no automatic trust or consent is carried over.
nodes.consequence_zh: 开启私人会面；不自动继承信任或同意。

nodes.why: 南部水闸或寂礁群通向潮汐葬运水域。
nodes.scene: 涨潮前辨读隐藏姓名；证人可自愿作证。
nodes.plot: 死者被定罪后无法安葬；原先的葬运开始服务于王室秘密。
nodes.eng: The erased names expose the social consequences of condemnation.
nodes.scene_en: Read concealed names before the tide rises; a witness may volunteer to speak.
nodes.consequence_en: Remember names; only present witnesses and copies can support restitution.
nodes.consequence_zh: 记住姓名；仅本轮证人与抄本能支持追偿。

nodes.why: 王闸通行后，沿潮汐浅道抵达圣堂。
nodes.scene: 压制钟楼圣光区域，再夺取档案室。
nodes.plot: 教会在沉船前已经拟定叛国判决。后期可发现被截留灵魂的运送记录。
nodes.reward: 抗圣光增益或专精兵种
nodes.eng: The date of the treason decree predates the sinking. Later records reveal diverted souls.
nodes.scene_en: Silence the bell tower’s holy field, then seize the record room.
nodes.consequence_en: Find the predated decree; Stage III reveals transfer records.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得提前拟定的判决；第三阶段揭示转运记录。

nodes.why: 第二阶段新结局后发现受限葬运路线，须本轮取得入口。
nodes.scene: 控制仪式码头，阻止转运且不毁记录。
nodes.plot: 确认永昼消耗被截留的完整灵魂，而非普通冥火。
nodes.eng: Restricted cargo proves the Seal consumes captive souls, not residual Soulfire.
nodes.scene_en: Secure the ceremonial jetty and stop the transfer without destroying the records.
nodes.consequence_en: K04 and present access to the ritual transport network.
nodes.consequence_zh: K04及本轮仪式运输网通行权。

nodes.why: 由王冠海道进入深水商港。
nodes.scene: 控制海关码头，守卫投降后与商人协商通行。
nodes.plot: 贸易账目、商人态度与摄政议会的经济基础将在宫城对质中发挥作用。
nodes.reward: 无新构筑奖励；王都入口
nodes.eng: The merchant waterfront offers leverage over the regency’s customs network.
nodes.scene_en: Secure the customs quay and negotiate a passage with merchants after the local guard yields.
nodes.reward_en: No new build reward; capital approach
nodes.consequence_en: Merchant witnesses and customs cooperation alter the confrontation.
nodes.consequence_zh: 商人证人与海关合作影响对质。

nodes.why: 通过黑浪船厂削弱舰队，或由王冠海道转向军港。
nodes.scene: 以军事压力或承认合法君主打开军港门。
nodes.plot: 王国军队的效忠对象取决于王子对王位的主张和此前取得的军令。
nodes.reward: 无新构筑奖励；王都入口
nodes.eng: The military quay carries the consequences of naval defections into the palace.
nodes.scene_en: Open the naval gate through military pressure or recognition of the lawful ruler.
nodes.reward_en: No new build reward; capital approach
nodes.consequence_en: Guard allegiance reflects current naval support, not past lives.
nodes.consequence_zh: 宫卫效忠反映本轮海军支持，不继承前世。

nodes.why: 控制王闸后沿王都粮船航线进入。
nodes.scene: 控制粮运登陆点，取得可用粮储清单。
nodes.plot: 本轮保全的粮食和冬港计划将影响冬政会议。
nodes.reward: 无新构筑奖励；王都入口
nodes.eng: Grain reserves and intact supply routes change the Winter Council.
nodes.scene_en: Secure the grain landing and obtain a statement of available stocks.
nodes.reward_en: No new build reward; capital approach
nodes.consequence_en: Supplies and transport inform the Winter Council.
nodes.consequence_zh: 粮储与运输影响冬政会议。

nodes.why: 从灵渡码头循受限葬运线进入王都。
nodes.scene: 沿仪式水道控制登陆点，取得本轮通行文书。
nodes.plot: 秘印设施的现世入口向王子开放。
nodes.reward: 无新构筑奖励；王都入口
nodes.eng: The procession route grants a current-history approach to the Seal.
nodes.scene_en: Follow the ceremonial waterway, secure its landing and obtain current access papers.
nodes.reward_en: No new build reward; capital approach
nodes.consequence_en: Present-run access to the hidden chamber; the lawful ruler still authorises intervention.
nodes.consequence_zh: 本轮取得秘印入口；干预仍需合法君主授权。

nodes.why: 从任一已攻克的王都入口进入宫城。
nodes.scene: 王室会面、摄政对质、军团集结、冬政会议、秘印、尾声；选择分开作出。
nodes.plot: 三个决定分阶段作出，塑造本轮结局。
nodes.eng: The capital unfolds through separate Crown, Oath and Day decisions.
nodes.scene_en: Audience, Council confrontation, Muster, Winter Council, Seal, epilogue; choices are separated.
nodes.consequence_en: Resolve Crown/Oath/Day and Return or qualified Final Crossing.
nodes.consequence_zh: 结算王权、军誓、永昼，回溯或符合条件时最终渡航。

nodes.why: 沿外海岸绕行至原赈粮目的港。
nodes.plot: 赈粮清单揭示原目的地。
nodes.eng: A relief manifest identifies the intended destination.
nodes.scene: 攻占外港并检查空赈粮仓，保护等待救济的家庭。
nodes.scene_en: Seize the outer harbour and inspect the empty relief store; spare the waiting families.
nodes.consequence_en: Recover the intended destination and promised cargo; no claim that the fleet ever arrived.
nodes.consequence_zh: 确认原目的地及承诺货物；不声称舰队曾抵达。

nodes.why: 从引航水道进入北方岗哨。
nodes.plot: 岗哨曾收到禁止救援的命令，副本尚存。
nodes.eng: The watch received an order to withhold assistance; a duplicate survives.
nodes.scene: 从岗哨塔下登陆，在巡逻队抵达北峡前切断警报。
nodes.scene_en: Land below the watch tower and disable the alert before a patrol reaches the northern passage.
nodes.consequence_en: Recover the duplicate rescue order; support K01 at the palace.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得禁救令副本，支援宫城K01。

nodes.why: 沿沿海盐贸航道前往税关。
nodes.plot: 罗德里克的垄断源自曾以船役换取的特权。
nodes.eng: Roderick’s monopoly was built on privileges once exchanged for ship service.
nodes.scene: 控制税关；可保全盐仓而非悉数掠夺。
nodes.scene_en: Secure the tollhouse; choose to preserve the salt depots rather than seize everything as spoils.
nodes.reward: 贸易储藏：两种补给增益择一
nodes.reward_en: Trade cache: choice of two supply boons
nodes.consequence_en: Expose charter abuses and preserve merchant cooperation when depots are spared.
nodes.consequence_zh: 揭露特许权滥用；保全盐仓可争取商人合作。

nodes.why: 军用海峡打开铁矿海岸。
nodes.plot: 元帅的动员在原有威胁消退后仍被延续。
nodes.eng: The marshal’s mobilisations outlasted the danger that justified them.
nodes.scene: 横穿暴露炉场，关闭炉门并控制甲具库。
nodes.scene_en: Cross exposed furnace yards, shut the blast gates and capture the armour depot.
nodes.consequence_en: Interrupt arms shipments and recover obsolete mobilisation orders.
nodes.consequence_zh: 截断军械运输并取得已经过时的动员令。

nodes.why: 沿岸渡线通往古战场登陆点。
nodes.plot: 投降者记录补全官方英雄叙事，不引入新的阴谋。
nodes.eng: Accounts of surrender challenge the official heroic version without revealing a new conspiracy.
nodes.scene: 探索古战场纪念地，对照王室与投降士兵记录。
nodes.scene_en: Search the old memorial field and compare royal and surrendered soldiers’ accounts.
nodes.consequence_en: Learn how old surrender agreements survived unification; no new conspiracy.
nodes.consequence_zh: 了解统一战争后的降约；不引入新阴谋。

nodes.why: 沿税渡水道继续内河航行。
nodes.plot: 家庭欠账展示王子征发令如何被反复抄发。
nodes.eng: Household arrears demonstrate how the prince’s warrant was copied.
nodes.scene: 控制税渡与账房；守军依托狭窄河道。
nodes.scene_en: Control the toll ferry and ledger office; defending formations use narrow river approaches.
nodes.consequence_en: Trace copies of Edmund’s warrant and record household arrears.
nodes.consequence_zh: 追查王子征发令抄件与家庭欠账。

nodes.why: 顺流前往地方行政码头。
nodes.plot: 地方请愿书揭示王都储粮与村庄口粮的冲突。
nodes.eng: Local petitions reveal a conflict between reserves for the capital and village rations.
nodes.scene: 控制行政庭院并保护请愿档案。
nodes.scene_en: Capture the civic courtyard and protect the petition archive from destruction.
nodes.reward: 预备支援：选择补给契约
nodes.reward_en: Reserve support: choose a supply contract
nodes.consequence_en: Recover regional ration petitions; intact records aid the winter allocation plan.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得地方口粮请愿；完整档案支持冬粮分配。

nodes.why: 浅水船沿南侧潮岸通行。
nodes.plot: 葬运水道早于秘印，早期记录展示原本用途。
nodes.eng: The funeral route predates the Seal; early records reveal its legitimate uses.
nodes.scene: 控制芦苇渡口；重装守军守堤时利用浅水路线。
nodes.scene_en: Secure a reed-lined crossing; use shallow approaches while heavy defenders hold the embankment.
nodes.consequence_en: Find legitimate old funeral ferry records, not the late secret itself.
nodes.consequence_zh: 发现古葬运的正当记录，不提前揭示后期秘密。

nodes.why: 避风沼泽水道连接墓园与静息院。
nodes.plot: 无人认领者过去曾得到照护与登记，后期名册却将其分类转送。
nodes.eng: Unclaimed people were once cared for and named; later registers classify them for transfer.
nodes.scene: 与照护者交谈并检查名册，不打扰住民。
nodes.scene_en: Speak to caretakers and inspect registers; let residents remain undisturbed.
nodes.consequence_en: Identify old charity registers and later classification of the unclaimed; witness consent remains local.
nodes.consequence_zh: 辨认早期慈善名册和后来的无人认领者分类；证人同意仅本轮有效。

nodes.why: 循旧王庭渡线进入北部避风湾。
nodes.plot: 创制寒冬账册区分初期临时仪式与后来的强制献祭。
nodes.eng: Founding winter accounts distinguish the original temporary ritual from later coercion.
nodes.scene: 勘察冰封宫厅并找到寒冬账册，不强制首领战。
nodes.scene_en: Survey frozen halls and recover the winter accounts; no compulsory boss.
nodes.consequence_en: Alternative evidence of the initial compact (K05); reveals why the court moved.
nodes.consequence_zh: 初始盟约的替代证据（K05），解释迁都原因。

nodes.why: 旧堡渡线连接残存桥头。
nodes.plot: 税碑显示王室曾通过共同出资修建基础设施。
nodes.eng: A toll inscription shows the Crown once financed infrastructure by shared contributions.
nodes.scene: 控制桥头渡船与断桥；用船绕过坍塌中拱。
nodes.scene_en: Secure the bridgehead ferry and collapsed span; boats bypass the broken central arch.
nodes.consequence_en: Reopen an old ferry connection toward the central anchorage.
nodes.consequence_zh: 重新打开通向中央锚地的古渡线。

nodes.why: 沿限制货运驳船线进入封印码头。
nodes.plot: 转运记录证实获罪灵魂的运输；记忆不替代本轮证据。
nodes.eng: Consignment records document the transfer of condemned souls; knowledge does not substitute for current proof.
nodes.scene: 在货册被转移前夺取封印仓库，控制仪式驳船。
nodes.scene_en: Capture the sealed warehouse before the cargo register is removed; secure the ritual barge.
nodes.consequence_en: Obtain present consignment papers and ritual access; no permanent possession of documents.
nodes.consequence_zh: 取得本轮托运文书与仪式通行权；实物不跨轮保留。
